headline: Trump Proposal to Cap US Credit Card Interest Rates Draws Bank Pushback
summary: US President Donald Trump proposed capping credit card interest rates at 10% per year, drawing interest from political rivals but warnings from commercial banks regarding reduced credit availability.
why: US commercial banks derive substantial interest income and consumer credit volume from credit card lending, where average annual rates exceed 22%.

impacts.name: US Commercial Banking Sector
impacts.why: Capping interest rates at 10% would severely restrict interest margins on consumer credit cards.
